{{Quest|Recover Sulphur}} |location=[[Chief's Hut]] |location_page_description = The leader of the [[Barbarian Faction]]. |x=-580.5 |y=115.5 |z=-687.5 }} '''Chief Scorn''' is an [[NPC]] found in the {{zone|Chief's Hut}} within {{zone|Dragontail}}, and is the leader of the [[Barbarian Faction]]. His son is [[Ugo]]. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable centertext" ! colspan="2" |Condition !Dialogue |- class="article-row-main" | colspan="2" |Whilst '''Chief Scorn''' Scolds [[Ugo]] |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, where have you been? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou had ONE job! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&l3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Well- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAnd you two, what are your names? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I'm- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lThank you for saving my rascal of a son. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAre you looking to join our ranks? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: No but- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lPerfect! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI welcome you both to the Barbarian Faction! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lIf you betray us you'll die. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I can't- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lEnough talking! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, go back out there and finish the job! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: But- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort them out of my Hut! }} |- | colspan="2" |After Stealing Research |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo why are you limping? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My le- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lHave you found the evil wizard machine? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Y- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGive it to the guards, we will investigate it. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lEnough with the mages and their shenanigans. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Alri- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &lThe Town Board is filling up and &lyou are late on your Training Ugo. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat have you been doing? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lHurry up, failure isn't an option. }} |- | colspan="2" | After completing {{NPCSprite|Gris}}'s quest |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lNewest member of the Faction! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lThe entire stash of Sulphur of the Piglin Faction has been stolen this morning. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI sent my son Ugo on a mission to recover the Sulphur. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lHe might be fighting the Mage Faction as we speak. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI implore you. Please assist Ugo in this operation. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI don't know what I would do without my son. My only son. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lThey have followed the traces of the Sulphur all the way to the Forgotten Skull in the North. }} |- | colspan="2" | Before defeating [[Kuudra]] |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lPlease help Ugo.}} |- | colspan="2" | After defeating [[Kuudra]] |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou finally retrieved the Sulphur. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat took you so long? &e[NPC] Ugo: &fA gian- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou even needed the help of those adventurers. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lDo you have no shame? &e[NPC] Ugo: &fI didn't- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lLook at the time. You are late to your training. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort my son out of the hut. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &7 &f&lI am in your debt. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lA father could not be prouder of his son. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMore importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI won't hold you any longer. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGood luck in your adventures. }} |- | colspan="2" rowspan="2"|Finished [[Crimson Isle Main Questline#Barbarians|Faction Questline]] |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI have an important meeting to attend.}} |- |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI am very busy right now.}} |- | class="ct" rowspan="3" |{{zone|The Garden}} | class="ct" | None | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &6Chief Scorn&f: Greetings, I am in dire need of my favorite snack.}} |- | class="ct" | Completing | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &6Chief Scorn&f: I lied about having an important meeting just to be here, glad it was worth it!}} |- | class="ct" | Denying | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &6Chief Scorn&f: That is...not ideal!}} |- |} == Trivia == *'''Chief Scorn''' is the only NPC that speaks in bold text. *It is possible to give '''Chief Scorn''' a {{Item|Bachelor's Rose}} while in the {{Faction|Mage}} if the player has met the 12,000 {{Reputation|barbarian}} requirement. This can be done by teleporting near '''Chief Scorn''' and quickly giving the Bachelor's Rose to '''Chief Scorn''' before the guards teleport the player out. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{history|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Chief Scorn.png|26px]] Added '''Chief Scorn'''.}} {{History|2025/Dec 5|Added '''Chief Scorn''' as a [[The Garden#Visitor|Garden Visitor]].}} |beta= {{history|0.13|[[File:Chief Scorn.png|26px]] Added '''Chief Scorn'''.}} {{History|2025/Dec 15|Added '''Chief Scorn''' as a [[The Garden#Visitor|Garden Visitor]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}}
